description: Agent-architecture evidence registry for the arckit-agent-architecture plugin. Registry-driven: 6 agent-architecture codes map to the plugin's 6 command files; no bundled JSON/YAML schemas — tools validate structure against the registry itself.

codes.description: Agent design — task decomposition, tool contracts, context windowing, memory strategy
Agent security — prompt-injection hardening, tool allowlists, egress control, PII handling
Agent governance — review cadence, audit logging, accountability, disposition rules
Agent integration — MCP/tool wiring, inter-agent handoffs, orchestrator contracts
Agent inventory — catalogue of agents, models, tool surfaces, owners, lifecycle
Agent maturity — capability-level scoring, capability gaps, transition plan

tools.name: agent_check_registry_coverage
tools.description: Validate that an agent-architecture evidence report covers the required registry codes. Checks that every mandatory code is cited, that all cited codes exist in the registry, and that no unknown ids are used. Returns valid, missing, unknown, and coverage_report.

codes.description: List of agent-architecture code ids (e.g. AGENT-DESIGN, AGENT-SECURITY) that the evidence report claims to cover.

mandatory.description: Subset of code ids that must appear; defaults to design + security, the two codes most agent-architecture evidence checks require.

tools.name: agent_check_tool_allowlist
tools.description: Check an agent-architecture design for tool-allowlist hygiene: every agent must declare a tools allowlist (deny-first pattern) and every referenced tool must appear in the plugin registry. Returns valid, problems, agent_count, unknown_tools.

agents.description: List of agent design objects; each should carry name, tools (allowlist), and optional tools_deny.

registered_tools.description: Tool names registered in the plugin / MCP catalog.
